headline: Apple faces court proceedings in France over restrictions on independent phone repairs
summary: Apple is set to face trial in France following allegations that the company restricts customers from repairing iPhones at non-official workshops, even when original parts are used.
why: Right-to-repair legal cases in Europe challenge proprietary hardware policies, influencing aftermarket device servicing revenue for tech manufacturers.

impacts.name: Apple Inc.
impacts.why: Legal proceedings in France target Apple's repair restrictions and spare parts policy.
